thread:
maria: Heads up — CI turned red on main for PR #4321, failing snapshot for prompt-render. Small punctuation/formatting delta in serialized output, not a full hallucination. Anyone seen this pattern before?

jamal: :eyes: I glanced at the job logs. Failing test is tests/prompt_render/test_prompts.py::test_prompt_json_output. Diff shows a trailing comma where there used to be a period. Might be serializer change in recent formatter refactor.

tess: Can you paste the minimal diff?

maria: pasted below from the CI artifact (trimmed):

```
-    "response": "Thanks for signing up.
Please confirm.
"
+    "response": "Thanks for signing up,
Please confirm.
"
```

jamal: that comma swap shifts punctuation for a handful of prompts, explains golden mismatch. Could be newline join behavior in serialization patch.

ci-bot: buildkite: job 3456 failed (prompt-render). artifacts: https://ci.example.com/builds/3456/artifacts/123

kai: Quick triage plan: 1) rerun the single job to rule out flake, 2) if still red, bisect commits since yesterday's green, 3) if deterministic, open a tiny revert/normalize PR.

maria: OK rerunning only the prompt-render job now. Command I used from local:

```
# rerun just the failing step
bk buildkite-agent pipeline upload --job prompt-render --commit 9b1f2a
```

(tess: FYI I'm oncall, will watch the rerun)

(t + 3m) jamal: if rerun still fails, run this to bisect locally:

```
git checkout main
# mark known good (yesterday's green)
git bisect start HEAD abc1234
git bisect run pytest tests/prompt_render/test_prompts.py::test_prompt_json_output
```

(tess: also check serializer changelog — there was a small join() -> sep change in recent PR 4299)

ci-bot: buildkite: rerun started (job 3456 re-run #2).

maria: rerun came back GREEN on rerun #2 :tada: — passes on same commit. Marking as flaky for now.

kai: nice. Can we add a quick unit to assert punctuation normalization so future refactors catch this? If flaky, add a flake tag and reopen if it reoccurs.

maria: created issue #789 to add a normalization test + link to the artifact. Will also add a one-line note to the serializer PR to avoid ambiguity.

jamal: thanks. If it resurfaces I'll start a bisect. For now marking as resolved. :thumbsup:
